high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a YouTube video titled "Why It Was Almost Impossible to Make the Blue LED" by Veritasium. The video has garnered 42 million views and was uploaded one year ago. The image prominently features three LEDs (light-emitting diodes) of different colors: red, green, and blue. Each LED is labeled with text indicating its difficulty level: The red LED is labeled "EASY." The green LED is also labeled "EASY." The blue LED is labeled "ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE." The LEDs are shown in a row, with the red and green LEDs appearing
